preconditions.description: The number of fish caught by Alice must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of fish caught by Bob must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of fish species must be between 1 and 1 billion.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= k for ai in alice_fish)
preconditions.description: All fish types caught by Alice must be within the range of 1 to k.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= bi <= k for bi in bob_fish)
preconditions.description: All fish types caught by Bob must be within the range of 1 to k.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(wi * count_a > wi * count_b for wi in range(1, k+1) for count_a in [alice_fish.count(wi)] for count_b in [bob_fish.count(wi)]) else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if there exists a weight assignment such that Alice's total weight is strictly greater than Bob's; otherwise, output 'NO'.
